evidence.note: silver-assembly-order-items-actual-amount-actual: Derived component consumption, not a count: FM actualamount = qty_per_batch x the AO's total produced finished-good units including samples (totalprodqty_c, not served by the reporting API), cascaded by the Portal (lib/inventory/assembly-lifecycle.ts:cascadeAssemblyActualQty). Every line equals the produced finished-good units x its BOM ratio (for example 1000 produced units x 0.25 gives 250). Divide by qty_per_batch to read produced finished goods. Not the same quantity as planned.

It is finished-good units only when qty_per_batch is 1; divide by qty_per_batch to read planned finished goods.
